schools.cons: Popular - lottery system, can be competitive for enrollment
schools.location: 4505 Antelope Ridge Drive, Castle Rock, CO
schools.name: Academy Charter School
schools.notes: One of the highest-performing charter schools in DCSD. Strong emphasis on reading and cultural literacy. Good option for academically-focused families. Waitlist typically available. Parent community is very engaged.
schools.philosophy: Rigorous, knowledge-based curriculum with strong emphasis on reading and foundational knowledge
schools.pros: Strong academics, excellent test scores, Core Knowledge curriculum, established community
schools.technology: Computer labs, 1:1 devices in upper grades

schools.cons: High parent volunteer expectation, STEM-focused (may not suit all learning styles), requires commitment
schools.name: STEM School Highlands Ranch
schools.notes: Excellent choice for families wanting innovative, project-based learning. Strong in math and problem-solving. Parent involvement is significant expectation. Note: School had security incident in past - now has excellent safety measures in place.
schools.outdoorSpaces: Nature area, garden space, outdoor learning environment
schools.philosophy: Project-based learning with emphasis on Science, Technology, Engineering, Math. Interdisciplinary approach.
schools.pros: Exceptional math scores, innovative STEM curriculum, modern facilities, hands-on learning, engaged parent community
schools.technology: Advanced STEM lab, 3D printers, coding robotics

schools.artsPrograms: Music, art, drama integrated into curriculum
schools.cons: Longer commute from Castle Rock/Lone Tree, strong volunteer expectation, smaller school
schools.name: Parker Core Knowledge Charter School
schools.notes: Great for families valuing reading and cultural knowledge. Strong community feel. Parent involvement is important. Good for kindergarteners - play-based transition year.
schools.philosophy: Classic Core Knowledge approach emphasizing strong reading skills, cultural literacy, and structured curriculum
schools.pros: Strong reading focus, Core Knowledge approach, engaging community, good test scores in reading
schools.transportation: Limited bus routes, mostly parent pickup

schools.cons: Classical approach not for everyone, strong volunteer expectations, limited SPED services, less technology focus
schools.location: 3450 Castle Pines Drive, Castle Rock, CO
schools.name: Leman Classical Academy
schools.notes: Ideal for families interested in classical education and strong academics. High parent involvement expected. Less tech-heavy than other options. Good for self-directed learners.
schools.philosophy: Classical education emphasizing grammar, logic, rhetoric stages. Great books, languages, classical curriculum
schools.pros: Excellent reading scores, classical curriculum, strong in language arts, smaller class sizes, disciplined environment
schools.technology: Moderate technology use, emphasis on traditional learning

schools.cons: Farther commute from most DCSD properties, less structured approach, no transportation, smaller school
schools.name: North Star Academy
schools.notes: Good alternative for families wanting progressive education. Multi-age classrooms mean learning at own pace. Commute challenging from Castle Rock/Lone Tree area.
schools.philosophy: Child-centered learning with Montessori principles. Multi-age classrooms, student-led pace
schools.pros: Progressive, child-centered approach, multi-age learning, good for self-directed learners, no volunteer requirement
schools.technology: Technology integrated thoughtfully, not primary focus
schools.transportation: No bus service - must provide transportation

schools.cons: Significant commute from Castle Rock/Lone Tree/Parker, larger school
schools.name: Skyview Academy
schools.notes: Out of area but worth considering if willing to commute. Good balanced approach. No strong volunteer expectations. K-8 structure provides continuity.
schools.philosophy: Balance of traditional academics and project-based learning. Whole-child focus
schools.pros: Good balance of academics and projects, K-8 continuation, good test scores, no volunteer requirement, strong extracurriculars

schools.cons: Newer school (still establishing reputation), smaller community, fewer extracurriculars than established schools
schools.location: 3100 Plum Creek Lane, Castle Rock, CO
schools.name: Plum Creek Academy
schools.notes: Excellent option for families in Castle Rock area. Close to Prairie Hawk Way and Wheatland Ridge properties. New school with strong leadership. Focus on character and community service. Very safe environment.
schools.philosophy: Strong academics with emphasis on character development and community service
schools.pros: Close to new homes, strong academics, good character education, no volunteer requirement, great community feel, excellent safety

schools.artsPrograms: Comprehensive arts including music, drama, visual arts
schools.cons: Competitive lottery entry, high expectations, demanding curriculum
schools.curriculum: Rigorous college-prep curriculum with focus on critical thinking
schools.giftedPrograms: Available (GT) - school designed for advanced learners
schools.name: Challenge to Excellence Charter School
schools.notes: TOP CHOICE - Consistently ranked as one of the best schools in Colorado. Rigorous college-prep curriculum. Very competitive entry. Focus on advanced learners. Excellent parent satisfaction. Strong arts and athletics programs.
schools.philosophy: Challenge students to achieve excellence through rigorous academics and character development
schools.pros: Highest-rated charter in area, excellent academics, rigorous curriculum, strong test scores, advanced learners focus

schools.artsPrograms: Music, visual arts with international focus
schools.cons: Lower test scores than other charters, less rigorous academics, ELL focus (may not suit all families)
schools.curriculum: International/global education focus with multicultural approach
schools.ellPrograms: Strong ELL program - school specializes in English language learners
schools.location: 3450 Castle Pines Drive, Castle Rock, CO
schools.name: World Compass Academy
schools.notes: GLOBAL EDUCATION FOCUS - Good for multilingual families or those valuing international perspective. Strong ELL program. PreK available. Close to Castle Rock properties. Less academically rigorous than other options.
schools.philosophy: Build global citizenship through international curriculum and cultural literacy
schools.pros: International/global focus, strong ELL program, K-8 with PreK, close to Castle Rock homes, no volunteer requirement

schools.cons: Moderate test scores, less rigorous than top charters, project-based approach not for all learners
schools.location: 8701 South Universal Boulevard, Highlands Ranch, CO
schools.name: Ben Franklin Academy
schools.notes: PROJECT-BASED LEARNING - Good alternative for Highlands Ranch families. PreK available. Student-centered approach. Less traditional than Core Knowledge schools. Good for creative learners.
schools.philosophy: Student-centered learning through projects and problem-solving with 18th century philosophy blend
schools.pros: Project-based innovative learning, close to Highlands Ranch homes, K-8 with PreK, no volunteer requirement, good community

schools.applicationProcess: DCSD Open Enrollment; verify campus choice
schools.cons: Strong volunteer expectation, classical approach not for everyone, limited SPED services, less tech-heavy
schools.curriculum: Classical education model - great books and classical curriculum
schools.name: Leman Classical Academy - Parker

schools.philosophy: Classical education emphasizing grammar, logic, rhetoric stages with timeless literature
schools.pros: Excellent reading scores, classical curriculum, strong language arts, disciplined environment, K-8 continuity
schools.technology: Moderate technology use, emphasizes traditional learning

schools.cons: Lower test scores than charter schools, less specialized approach, serves average rather than advanced
schools.curriculum: Traditional public-style curriculum with some enrichment
schools.location: 5200 Aspen View Drive, Castle Rock, CO
schools.name: Aspen View Academy
schools.notes: BACKUP OPTION - Very close to Castle Rock properties (6 min commute). Lower test scores but serves all learners well. PreK available. Good fallback option if competitive charters don't work out.
schools.philosophy: Serving diverse learners with traditional academics and community focus
